The Fannie Mae Conventional Properties term sheet (retrieved 2026-09-07) states a maximum LTV of 80% and a minimum DSCR of 1.25x for existing stabilized multifamily with at least five units. The subject is a stabilized 50-unit property with DSCR 1.30 (meets the DSCR floor and unit-count floor), but the requested 85% LTV is above the disclosed 80% maximum, and no leverage exception or waiver is documented in the evidence packet. The only exception language in the source is narrow and unrelated to leverage: it applies to pre-stabilized occupancy receiving case-by-case consideration, not to LTV above the maximum. Accordingly, the request as structured does not fit the disclosed criteria; a restructured request at or below 80% LTV would instead be an amount/criteria-fit question rather than an eligibility failure, but that is not what was asked. The Freddie Mac Conventional Small announcement is not applicable to Fannie Mae conventional term-sheet fit and, by its own terms, does not state a complete set of underwriting criteria.
